design.arms: naive fuses at receive time while recovery fuses at capture time and drops late out-of-order packets
design.cell_label_rule: a cell is labelled fails when at least half of its seeds fail, otherwise passes
design.criterion: a seed fails when its scored-window p95 error exceeds 0.25 m or its maximum error exceeds 0.5 m (a research criterion, not a safety limit)
design.interval: distribution-free 95% order-statistic interval for medians (for 50 seeds the 18th and 33rd smallest values, coverage 96.7%; with 5 or fewer seeds it falls back to min and max) and Wilson 95% interval for failure rates
design.statistic: per-cell medians of per-seed p95 error, with paired per-seed recovery differences

limits: simulated link and sensor (synthetic, not measured)
recovery drops late out-of-order packets (no retrodiction)
fixed tuning: measurement std 0.05 m (R = 0.0025 m^2) and q = 0.1 m^2/s^3, except the labelled oracle slice
targets at 1.0 m/s, turn radius 1.0 m
criterion is a research choice, not a safety limit
status: synthetic investigation: simulated link and sensor, not flight performance
